# Deterministic local theme font fixture

`FiraCode-VariableFont_wght.woff2` is the unmodified variable font bundled with WordPress Twenty Twenty-Five. It reproduces a theme-provided face finishing after the widget's Google stylesheet fails, without relying on external font transport or operating-system font metrics.

This fixture is test-only and is not included in the widget or WordPress package.
